description: An enterprise collaboration suite providing chat, docs, calendar, and workflow tools with a broad developer platform and APIs.
auth_notes: Uses OAuth2 authorization code flow and tenant/user access tokens for API requests.
credential_notes: Developers can sign up and create apps on the Lark Open Platform developer console for free.
api_notes: Offers over 2500+ APIs covering Contacts, Messenger, Calendar, Drive, Doc, Sheet, Base, Wiki, and approvals.
mcp_notes: Official Model Context Protocol (MCP) server published by Larksuite (`larksuite/lark-openapi-mcp`), alongside the Lark CLI and agent plugins.
rationale: Lark provides comprehensive public REST/WebSocket APIs, self-serve free developer credentials, official SDKs, and an official MCP server.

evidence.note: Details on tenant and user access token mechanisms.
Open Platform documentation for creating apps and developer tools.
Lark Developer homepage showcasing 2500+ APIs across Messenger, Docs, Calendar, Base, etc.
Official Lark GitHub organization hosting lark-openapi-mcp and the Lark CLI tool.
